regime.summary: SBP hiked 100bp on 2023-01-23 to 17.0% while CPI is still rising and the rupee is down 23.3% in 3 months. KMI is down on 1m, 3m, 6m and 12m. The past hike-cycle lesson in the method files says read the rate and the rupee. No cut is visible, so stay mostly in cash with two low-multiple, cash-yielding names.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 17.0%; last MPC decision 2023-01-23: hike (+100bp)
Lesson: read the rate and the rupee, not the politics.

core.thesis: Trades near its 252-day high while the market falls, on a P/E of 2.5 and a 9.2% dividend yield; E&P is the only sector with a positive 3m return. Brent fall is a risk. Modest size only.
Flat over 12 months while the market fell, P/E 4.8 and dividend yield 21.7%; a defensive cash-yielding holding in a hiking phase. Results are not rising (eps_yoy slightly negative).
